title: Compute scaling can expose a shared bottleneck
method: Synthetic throughput: 4×12=48 ideal jobs/minute, limited to 36 by a shared database; 36/12=3× observed capacity. Assumes identical jobs and no other bottleneck.
alt: Compute scaling can expose a shared bottleneck: One worker 12 jobs/minute, Four-worker ideal 48 jobs/minute, Shared DB limit 36 jobs/minute. Illustrative inputs.
